title: fix(ui): name clearance links when the retract hop is off
body:
Stacked on #3353. The PR base is `issue/3316-offset-pass-start`, as the review permits.
Retarget this PR to `main` BEFORE #3353 merges. Then merge `upstream/main` into this branch and run the gate again.
The base change keeps the old parent code out of this PR's diff.

## What changed

The 2D Offset and 2D Adaptive Lead tab names the effective link plane.
With Hop below clearance off, the retract choice reads `Clearance plane (hop off)`.
With a configured hop, it reads `Retract plane`.
The Keep down fallback hint names the same plane.
The stored link choice does not change.

## Cause

The shared roughing pane did not pass its optional retract state to the Lead tab.
The tab always named a separate retract plane.
The generator uses clearance when the retract height is absent.
The Heights tab and viewport already show the correct plane.

## Tests

- `offset_retract_links_name_the_visible_plane`
- `adaptive_retract_links_name_the_visible_plane`

Both pins failed on unchanged production code before the fix.
Both pass with the fix.
They check both hop states, both link rows, Heights rows, viewport labels, stored values, and the Keep down hint.

Mutation: restored `lead_page.rs` from `upstream/main` and restored the original caller line.
Both pins failed with the expected label assertion.
Restored the fixed files. Both pins passed.
The caller restoration kept the inherited pass-start changes buildable.

That first build stalled with sccache. A command-local empty wrapper let the build complete.

## Goldens moved

None for this fix. The diff from parent head `59b42c727` changes no `.nc` or `.cl` file.
The direct diff against `upstream/main` shows two files absent from the older parent base:

- `docs/tester-kits/fanuc-mgi-blank/mgi_blank_bar.nc`: all 20 lines are absent.
- `docs/tester-kits/fanuc-mgi-blank/mgi_blank_box.nc`: all 20 lines are absent.

These are ancestor differences. This commit does not delete or change either file.

## Screenshots

These screenshots show the 2D Offset Lead tab with the same fixture in each state.
The fixture stores `Link::Retract` for both link rows.
The hop-off fixture has no retract height. The hop-on fixture has a retract height of 25 mm.
Each image uses the production `params_fields` page and the existing egui harness at 600 by 1200 pixels.
The before images restore the original `leads_tab` caller. The after images use the current head.
No snapshot golden changed. The temporary capture test and caller change were removed.

The review-round mutation restored the original caller in `kind_editors.rs`.
Both regression pins failed at `retract_link_tests.rs:47`: zero effective-plane labels instead of two.
After the fixed caller was restored, both pins passed. The worktree was clean before the final gates.

## Not exercised

No full application GUI session or release pixel snapshot lane ran.
The screenshots above render the production Lead tab through the existing egui test harness.
Other operation families keep their existing link display behavior.

## Overlaps

- #3353 changes `kind_editors.rs::roughing2d_pane`. This branch starts at its head.
- #3251 changes `heights_tests.rs::an_unresolved_relation_says_why_never_a_number`.
  It touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes.

Process change: yes

The process change is the inherited MCP skill row from #3353.
The #3318 commit changes no process file and does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Effort: medium
